from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its case cause and relevant facts."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as named (e.g., '判决文书1')")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The official case cause/案由 as stated in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The broad case category: 'civil', 'administrative', etc.")
    involves_administrative_act: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the case involves a specific administrative act from an administrative organ")
    involves_administrative_act_revocation: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the case involves a claim or ruling to revoke an administrative act")
    relevant_facts: str | None = Field(description="Brief facts supporting whether this document matches the target case cause")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
